   ## Hypothesis

   <2-3 sentences: what edge are we trying to capture, why does it exist>

   We are testing the hypothesis that putting a VIX floor of 20 for put entries (i.e., only take put trades when VIX>=20) 
   will improve the edge capture on the J anchor days by avoiding losing put trades in low VIX environments and capturing 
   the big winners in high VIX environments.

   ## Mechanism

   <concrete: what bars / indicators / state triggers entry, what's the exit logic>

   The mechanism is: 
     - Entry trigger: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (as defined in the playbook) 
     - Additional filter: only allow the entry if the current VIX (at the time of entry) is >= 20.
     - Exit logic: as per the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop).
